mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: it showed where the diaphragm sits and how vessels, nerves and the food pipe cross between regions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two organs into the lower body's named slots was straightforward but a little repetitive; there was not much to figure out once the slots were named.

surprise.text: The lymph network lined up with an existing neck-vein junction rather than adding another one. That made the connections between regions clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though some fittings followed named slots rather than requiring much reasoning.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored connections in a new way. Seeing nerves and blood both support the same muscle was more interesting than simply filling slots.
